title: Rotated Beacon
description: A strictly increasing integer array has been rotated at an unknown position. Find the zero-based index of a target value, or -1 if it is absent.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; all values are distinct; -10^9 <= values[i], target <= 10^9.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: the rotated array. Third line: target.
outputFormat: Print the zero-based index of the target, or -1.
hints: At every step, one half of the rotated array remains sorted. Determine which half contains the target.

examples.explanation: 4 appears at index 4 in the rotated array.
8 is not present in the rotated array.
